arguments.value: After cloning the Ubuntu system drive from HDD to SSD and updating fstab and resume UUIDs, the machine boots but has a 20–30 second silent pause early in boot before EXT4/systemd start messages. The delay disappears if the old HDD is connected, even without mounting it, suggesting boot is waiting on something tied to the old drive/UUIDs. User asks what is causing the delay.
